package.manifest: forever-package.json with deterministic per-table partial-section declarations only
package.partial_encrypted_tables: Only per-table Map declarations are admitted, bound to dbc/<locale>/Map.db2; a complete table has no declaration.
package.partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden in the package manifest; the same-named PLAN gate remains mandatory
package.global_partial_encrypted_sections: forbidden; no global or package-wide declaration is admitted
package.present_empty_maps: A present active map with no placements retains its tree and empty proof; it is distinct from WDT omission, vacated WMO or intrinsically empty WMO declarations.
package.root_absent_maps: Every WDT ROOT-absent active map remains in Coverage.maps without tree, proof, tile or model artifacts.
package.vacated_wmo: A WMO vacated after a local WMO doodad M2 ROOT-absence omission remains in missing_wmo, separately from empty_wmo. No VMO, binding, valid name, spawn, placement or model ID is emitted for it.
package.empty_wmo: An intrinsically empty WMO FileDataId has no local M2 omission and no usable geometry before omission. It is declared only in empty_wmo and emits no VMO, binding, valid name, spawn, placement or model ID.
package.present_wmo_with_missing_doodad: Retain the present parent WMO and each present doodad, including VMO, binding, valid name, spawn and placement; omit only the declared absent M2 child.
package.unselected_wmo: A FileDataId-origin WMO is declared only when local_missing_m2=0, omitted_usable=false, output=None, bindings and selection references are empty, and the root has present nonempty selection sets. At least one group has a skip_reason and nonempty source triangle, index and vertex counts; no unskipped group has all three source counts nonempty. A skipped group's source geometry is not selected geometry and is not proof of intrinsic emptiness. A non-skipped group's triangles all filtered by material do not admit unselected_wmo. Useful output or selection/references preclude this declaration but can proceed as normal Collision/DoodadOnly. RAW output=None alone is not fatal when there is a normal DoodadOnly result. Failure remains fatal when RAW output is absent, no normal DoodadOnly result exists, and no complete admitted WMO omission predicate applies. Required-source acquisition or parser errors are always fatal; no WMO omission declaration compensates for them. Omitted WMO IDs have no model artifacts, bindings, valid names, spawns, placements or consumed placement IDs.

coverage_codec.maps: the complete active domain, including Present and WDT RootAbsent entries; maps=wdt_files+root_absent
coverage_codec.missing_m2: canonical ordered unique nonzero WMO doodad M2 FileDataIds after Coverage.maps; direct ADT M2 IDs are never included
coverage_codec.missing_wmo: canonical ordered unique nonzero WMO FileDataIds vacated after local ROOT-absent M2 omissions; disjoint from missing_m2, empty_wmo and unselected_wmo
coverage_codec.empty_wmo: canonical ordered unique nonzero intrinsically empty WMO FileDataIds immediately after missing_wmo and before unselected_wmo; disjoint from missing_m2, missing_wmo and unselected_wmo
coverage_codec.unselected_wmo: Canonical ordered unique nonzero FileDataId-origin WMO IDs, immediately after empty_wmo and disjoint from all other omission lists; admission requires local_missing_m2=0, omitted_usable=false, output=None, empty bindings and selection.references, and present nonempty selection sets. At least one skipped group must have nonempty source triangle/index/vertex counts, and no unskipped group may have all three counts nonempty.
coverage_codec.vacated_wmo_admission: WMO FileDataId origin; at least one local guarded ROOT-absent M2 doodad omission; no geometry output; no remaining bindings; MODR participated in selection; selection references empty after omission
coverage_codec.empty_wmo_admission: WMO FileDataId origin; local_missing_m2=0; omitted_usable=false before any omission; output=None; bindings empty; selection sets present; selection references empty; no remaining geometry or usable dependency

coverage_codec.binding: V35 binds coverage v8 and its four separately canonical omission lists to the v35 plan, RequestHeavyV1, all active maps and mask 17. V34 remains coverage v7 and cannot be relabeled as v35.
coverage_codec.unselected_wmo_admission: FileDataId origin; local_missing_m2=0; omitted_usable=false; output=None; bindings and selection.references empty; selection sets present and nonempty; at least one group has skip_reason with nonempty source triangles, indices and vertices; no unskipped group has all three source counts nonempty. Useful output or selection/references preclude this declaration but can produce normal Collision/DoodadOnly. A non-skipped group's material-filtered-to-zero triangles are not an unselected predicate. RAW output=None alone is not fatal when a normal DoodadOnly result exists; when RAW output is absent, there is no normal DoodadOnly result, and no complete admitted omission predicate applies, failure remains fatal. Required-source acquisition or parser errors are always fatal and cannot be compensated by a WMO omission declaration.

source_policy.resource_profile: RequestHeavyV1 changes only collector.max_requests and startup_limits().collision.max_requests from BoundedV1 defaults to 16000000. V35 adds no resource ceiling change over v32, v33 or v34. reads, dependency_requests, source_bytes, raw_bytes, models, per-file/parser/memory ceilings, disk/spool, inventory, stage, model, package and list-profile limits remain unchanged; this is not DiskWorldV1 and is never implicit.
source_policy.request_calls: RequestHeavyV1 raises only max_requests. Requests may retain model handles, so unchanged collector and startup memory limits remain enforced; any over-limit or memory failure remains fatal with no accepted prefix.
source_policy.db2_map: Publish exactly canonical Map FDID 1349477 through the disabled-key build-70450 available-source route with structural, exact partial-extent and zero-fill checks.
source_policy.partial_sections: Use per-table declared-skip rules for Map. Declarations remain per table; no decryption or key material is admitted.
source_policy.vmap_map_projection: Read sealed Map with read_vmap_maps_70450 and materialize its VMap projection. Re-derive sections and direct/copy/materialized facts. WDT==0 rows participate in graph/materialization but not active_maps or ROOT omission lists.
source_policy.domain: Build Maps::from_materialized_selection over the complete graph with MapSelection::All. Coverage contains every active map and never adds IDs hidden by omitted Map sections.
source_policy.wdt_root_absence: Only WDT MissingFile followed by guarded raw-ROOT zero-row proof may produce RootAbsent. WDT==0, omitted Map rows, ineligible ROOT, central/encoding absence and corruption are not such proof.
source_policy.model_root_absence: Only a WMO doodad M2 requested by FileDataId while converting a present WMO, with guarded root_has_no_rows(id) before child acquisition, may be declared. Each child increments dependency_requests, not top-level request_calls; it has zero child model_reads. Direct ADT M2 and logical-name requests are never eligible.
source_policy.vacated_wmo: Declare in missing_wmo only a WMO FileDataId whose own conversion observed at least one locally declared ROOT-absent M2 doodad; output is None, bindings are empty, MODR participated in selection and selection.references is empty after omission. An unused dependency, absent MODR participation, remaining geometry/binding, logical origin or unrelated failure remains fatal.
source_policy.empty_wmo: V35 keeps the V34 intrinsic-empty classification: unselected source geometry is never empty_wmo. V34 acceptance is not transferred to v35.
fatal_not_model_or_wmo_absence: direct ADT M2 Target::FileDataId even when raw ROOT has zero rows
M2 Target::Name or any logical-name request
WMO root or WMO group absence or malformed data
M2 with ROOT present but ineligible, central CKey absent, encoding absent or corrupt
dependency not used in MODR selection
conversion/no-collision without the complete vacated-WMO, intrinsically-empty-WMO or present-but-unselected-WMO predicate

an unselected_wmo declaration is not admitted when local_missing_m2!=0, omitted_usable=true, bindings/references are nonempty, selection sets are absent or empty, no skipped group has nonempty source triangles/indices/vertices, or an unskipped group has all three source counts nonempty; these conditions do not invalidate normal Collision/DoodadOnly output

a non-skipped group whose collision triangles are all filtered by material is not unselected_wmo; if RAW output is absent, no normal DoodadOnly result exists, and no other complete admitted predicate applies, failure remains fatal

RAW output=None without a normal DoodadOnly result and without a complete admitted WMO omission predicate; a normal DoodadOnly result or a complete admitted predicate prevents this condition from being fatal
any required-source acquisition or parser error, regardless of WMO omission declarations
invalid associations, input guard changes and resource-limit failures
source_policy.omitted_model_effects: An omitted WMO doodad has zero child model_reads and no model handle, VMO, NameBinding, valid name or spawn. A present parent WMO and each present doodad remain, and missing_m2 is ordered, unique and bounded by the existing model ceiling.
source_policy.root_absent_map_effects: Skip WDT parser, globals, processing, placements, model requests, IDs, cache and callbacks for WDT ROOT-absent maps while retaining their active graph/coverage entries.
source_policy.present_effects: Present maps retain strict acquisition. Present empty maps have tree and empty proof; populated maps retain exact artifacts for every present WMO and doodad placement. report.maps includes all active maps and report.wdt_files counts present WDT inputs.
source_policy.parent_replay: If the immediate parent is WDT ROOT-absent, do not publish or verify parent-only inheritance and do not skip to a populated grandparent. A child with its own WDT continues without inheritance.
source_policy.root_absence_authentication: producer_reported; offline verification cannot independently reproduce raw ROOT absence for WDT inputs.
source_policy.model_absence_authentication: producer_reported; offline verification cannot independently prove WMO-doodad M2 ROOT absence or reconstruct original omitted requests and spawns.
source_policy.wmo_absence_authentication: producer_reported; offline verification cannot independently prove conversion-time vacating after a local absent-M2 omission or intrinsic geometry absence before omission.
source_policy.source_authentication_flags: CKey/EKey acquisition facts are producer-reported, not independent cryptographic source authentication.
source_policy.gameobjects: GODI and global GameObject startup are excluded by profile policy. No GameObjectDisplayInfo request or GameObjectModels.dtree output is admitted.
source_policy.liquids: LiquidMaterial and LiquidType retain complete strict checks. LiquidObject is out of scope and is not requested.
source_policy.failure_policy: Only guarded WDT ROOT absence, WMO-doodad M2 ROOT absence, the exact vacated-WMO predicate, intrinsic-empty predicate and v35 present-but-unselected predicate are declarable. Required-source acquisition and parser errors are always fatal and no WMO omission declaration compensates for them. RAW output=None alone is not fatal when normal DoodadOnly output exists. If RAW output is absent, there is no normal DoodadOnly result, and no complete admitted WMO omission predicate applies, failure remains fatal. Every unrelated source, graph, placement, model, association, conversion or limit failure remains fatal.
source_policy.unselected_wmo: Declare only a FileDataId-origin WMO with local_missing_m2=0, omitted_usable=false, output=None, empty bindings and selection.references, and present nonempty root selection sets. At least one group must have skip_reason with nonempty source triangle, index and vertex counts, and no unskipped group may have all three source counts nonempty. Skipped source geometry is not selected useful geometry and is not proof of intrinsic emptiness. A non-skipped group whose collision triangles are all removed by material filtering is not unselected. Useful output or selection/references preclude the unselected declaration but are not automatically fatal: they may produce normal Collision or DoodadOnly outcomes. Required-source acquisition/parser errors are always fatal, even if a WMO omission declaration otherwise applies. RAW output=None without a normal DoodadOnly result and without a complete admitted omission predicate remains fatal.
